div.l: He wolde thresshe and therto dygge and delue
For crystis sake for euery poure wyght
Wythoute hyre yf it lay in hys myght
Hys tythes payde he bothe fayre and wel
Of hys propyr swynk and hys catel
In a tabard he rood vp on a mere
There was also a reue and eek a Myllere
A sompnour and a pardoner also
A Mancipill and my self ther was no mo
TThe myllere was a stout carle for the nonys
Ful byge he was of braun and bonys
That proued wel for oueral there he cam
At wrastlynge alwey he wolde haue the ram
He was short shuldred brood a thycke quarre
Ther was no dore that he nolde heue of the barre
Or breke it at rennynge wyth hys hed
